title: basalt-plugin.json.sig
description: The signature next to a plugin's manifest. sig is ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256 over the line basalt-plugin-manifest.1 and a newline followed by the manifest's exact bytes, as 64 bytes r ‖ s, base64url without padding. keyId names the signer's key: base64url of the first 16 bytes of sha256 of its SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER. See CONTRACT.md, Plugins, Signing and the trust store.
